items.evidence: ENV-2_hour_ward_ab.png plus my own recapture _harness/_shots/maxenv/verify1/rift_core.png (High, t=20): core, both base turrets and the inner gate are now opaque stone with readable form and value; only a hairline rim and the plinth ticks show protection. Turret upper cages still carry a cool blue-grey cast but no longer read as X-ray glass. Largest visible gain of the lane.

ENV-3_hour_stone_ab.png and recapture verify1/fray_stones.png: lid seam and chalk stripe gone, bronze dial boss, edge chips and stepped courses added. Residual: at the game camera the silhouette is still one long dark rectangular block with a round emblem on top; the two offset blocks barely separate and the sloped top does not read, so the casket cue is reduced, not removed.

ENV-4_water_ab.png: the flat film now has two moving ripple sets, soft sky streaks and a teal depth shift. Still dark and modest at game zoom. Outflow pane, foam rings and mist not done (claimed honestly in notDone).

ENV-6_rubble_ab.png: a persistent rubble trail along the fall now exists where the stump was clean. The blocks read as flat-shaded grey boxes with one near-black chip, so they look placeholder-like next to the textured plinth; no soot decal or dust pall.

ENV-8_map_grades_ab.png: subtle, distinct moods (BRIDGE warmer amber, FRAY cream, RIFT slightly cooler shade). Luma kept; value_probe_maxenv.json maxenv_final passes every B5 gate on all three maps. STYLE_BIBLE Grade line updated to record the per-map LUTs; no owner ruling locks the single LUT.

ENV-9_sharpen_ab.png at 1:1: off and on are near indistinguishable by eye on jungle, XI and core; the measured +19-32 % high-pass gain comes with the same rise in pan flicker. Programs 39 unchanged, no pass added. Not harmful, not a visible upgrade.

ENV-10_cloud_shadow_ab.png: soft drifting blotches over the Seat at ~20 m scale, gentle and readable; fighters excluded. Luminance-neutral rework fixed the first-pass BRIDGE/FRAY lane p50 FAILs (82/84 -> PASS in maxenv_after2 and maxenv_final).

ENV-1_jungle_ab.png and recapture verify1/rift_jungle_w.png: the Gnomon column adds a second silhouette and per-crown value/hue variation breaks the carpet a little. The core problem (one fan-plate species, no understory, no lit crown tops) mostly remains; the tick-fern layer, top-light bake and thinning were not done.

ENV-7_shadow_slab_cap_ab.png and recapture verify1/rift_slab2.png: the glaring white lid is gone (L* p50 61.9 -> 37.5), which is right, but the carved band reads as rows of vent slots, like a radiator grille, rather than an hour band. Net about even.

problems.what: RIFT jungle (about 30 % of the frame) is still essentially one Dialwood fan species with no understory or lit crown tops
problems.evidence: verify1/rift_jungle_w.png; ENV-1 remainder in the engineer's notDone
problems.fix: Ship the tick-fern shrub layer, the vertex top-light bake and the 15-20 % thinning from the plan, within the Ultra triangle headroom.

problems.what: Fallen Shaft outflow is still a translucent pane with a hard bright bottom edge
problems.evidence: ENV-4 outflow lip in notDone; outflow region unchanged
problems.fix: Foam crest, falling streaks and a mist puff (ambient.ts and map ambient data), or reshape the pane into a curved lip.

problems.what: FRAY hour stones still read as long dark rectangular boxes from the game camera
problems.fix: Separate the two blocks more clearly (a visible gap or height step of 20 cm or more) and tilt the reading top so it catches light.

problems.what: Rubble blocks are flat-shaded untextured grey boxes, one near black
problems.fix: Sample the plinth texture by UV (not one flat colour per block), bevel or chip the blocks, and clamp the darkest face to the plinth's value range.

problems.what: Shadow-slab cap tick band reads as vent slots
problems.fix: Use fewer, shallower ticks (the 12 hours only) on the top face, with the quarter marks clearly longer, and drop the side rows.

problems.what: Base plaza dressing, tower soot/dust, god rays and BRIDGE deck bays were not started
problems.evidence: engineer's notDone (ENV-5, ENV-6 extras, ENV-10 god rays, ENV-11)

budgets: Measured on the current build (perf_1080 --prod --q high,ultra, fresh prod build, load 13-80 so timing NOT valid and not claimed): High 329k tris / 189 draws / 39 programs; Ultra 268k / 157 / 39 at the bench spot. max_env_shots High recapture: RIFT core 128k/153/39, gate 146k/159/39, jungle_w 165k/112/39, shaft 182k/104/39; FRAY centre 132k/99/30, stones 37.5k/70/30. All within <= 500k tris, <= 450 draws, <= 40 programs per frame. Memory: match peak renderer+GPU 2044 MB (match_4_rift) <= 3000; Home peak 1006 MB <= 2500; 4 rebuilds +2.5 % PASS (memmaps programs 41 at the 4th match is the cumulative cache count and matches earlier reports, e.g. fw_CW1_r3x_perf.log). GATE PASS. typecheck exit 0; content:check OK, 0 warnings; probes content_build, content_ids, maps, render_dynres, render_dynres_vsync, sim_determinism, sim_structures all PASS. value_probe maxenv_final passes on all three maps.
sensitivity_originality: No hoods, faces or masks introduced. Hour-ward ticks, dial stones, gnomon column and per-map grades are VALE's own sundial vocabulary; nothing copied from LoL.
notes: The lane is clearly better overall: the protected-structure fix alone removes the most visible unfinished read in base fights, and water, stones, rubble, clouds and grades each add a modest but real gain with zero program growth. ENV-9 sharpen is invisible at 1:1 and ENV-7 is a wash. Score 7.3 vs the LoL gauge: environment is coherent and solid, but the jungle monotony and the outflow pane keep it below par 7.5.
